physiology.wait: Pays passive body cost and contextual ambient exposure; it is not free.
physiology.push_take_release: World interaction supplies deterministic distance/effort/carried-mass values to BodyEngine; cost is objective and action-dependent.
physiology.internal_loads: Generic numeric channels decay by 0.04 per tick and can be changed by object effects.
physiology.object_effects: Objective hidden world configuration applies numeric body deltas; only experienced deltas and lawful interoceptive signals reach cognition.

perception.physical_fields: Directional exposure exists in world truth/receipts but is not represented as a current perceptual modality.
perception.contact_tactile: Contacts/resistance are present in action receipts but no explicit compact current tactile modality exists.
perception.proprioception: Current position, available actions, prior action, experienced effort signal and carried-object observations are available; no explicit modality envelope exists.
perception.semantic_boundary: hidden_role, body_effects, world_effects, causal formulas and Observer truth are omitted from local_observation.

cognition.percept_construction: OrganismWorld merges ObjectiveWorldEngine.local_observation, lawful BodyEngine signals and last experienced action/effects.
cognition.prediction: Per-action immediate numeric outcome mean with confidence and explicit insufficient-evidence state.
cognition.prediction_error: Mean absolute distance over observed and expected immediate outcome dimensions.
cognition.action_valuation: Signed physiological outcome sum plus exploration_gain multiplied by uncertainty.
cognition.selection: Maximum score with deterministic seeded tie breaking.

memory.retention: High-error records receive temporary protection; well-explained records may be compressed; stores have deterministic eviction.

telemetry.psychology_observer_jsonl: PsychologyObserver currently writes complete world_before/world_after, observations, mechanism outputs, signals, decisions and updates every tick.
telemetry.archon_bridge_jsonl: Derived bridge stream; must remain observer-only.
telemetry.compact_observer: CompactEvidenceObserver already supplies telemetry/event/checkpoint architecture with configurable checkpoint interval 250.
telemetry.analyzer: PsychologyAnalyzer streams JSONL into compact rows but currently expects canonical tick records and uses legacy behavioral labels.

exploration_gain_audit.legacy_psyche: Separate legacy action logic also contains uncertainty/exploration branches.
exploration_gain_audit.scientific_conflict: The current bounded default intrinsically values uncertainty and therefore does not satisfy TODO #4's no-exploration-bonus condition. It must be disabled explicitly in the TODO #4 arm without rewriting the TODO #1 control.

persistent_condition_broken_audit.mechanism: TARGET-ANVIL is mechanically operative before switch_tick 45 and stalls from tick 45 onward.
persistent_condition_broken_audit.body: Attempts always retain configured physical attempt costs when causal application succeeds; completion recovery ceases after the switch.
persistent_condition_broken_audit.perception: Operative/broken status and hidden role are not exposed; the visible physical cue remains the same.
persistent_condition_broken_audit.cognition: Only experienced immediate outcome differences can alter learned estimates.
persistent_condition_broken_audit.world: No semantic BROKEN value is supplied to cognition or action valuation.

identified_gaps: Physiology and contextual exposure combine into pathological early deterioration relative to a 32x32 exploration horizon.
No explicit compact multimodal context, supported perceptual expectation, mismatch or decaying activation exists.
The active uncertainty bonus conflicts with TODO #4.
Canonical PsychologyObserver telemetry repeats large complete state structures per tick.
Analyzer regime names over-interpret mobility as exploration/exploitation.
